levels.surface: سعد بن عبد الله بن أبي خلف

notes: The bracketed «[الحسن]» is the text's own alternative reading and is kept inside the surface as written
«قال لما هم الحسين» is the speech of محمد بن علي, named after «عن» inside the chain, so he stays a narrator (owner ruling 2)
The verses of lament after the saying are poetry and are not a route

fixes.reason: THQ's English sanad gives a different chain from the Arabic: the text names الحسين بن موسى الأصم, عمرو, جابر, محمد بن علي, not عباد بن يعقوب and عمرو بن ثابت

evidence.quote: قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْحُسَيْنُ [الْحَسَنُ] بْنُ مُوسَى الْأَصَمُّ
from ‘Abbād ibn Ya’qūb, from ‘Amr ibn Thābit
